integrity: Analytical proof supported by finite numerical checks; neither code tests nor literature search imply independent certification.
scientific_limitations: General radial Toeplitz diagonalization and beta-prime eigenvalue formulas are previously known; the claims of new content concern mode transitions and sharp fixed-area boundary spectral, Schatten, and effective-rank limits. No statement about arbitrary windows, nonradial sets, or joint parameter scalings. Earlier equivalent asymptotics remain possible.
scientific_scope: Probability-normalized analytic weighted Bergman compression to centered hyperbolic annuli of fixed invariant area, with fixed positive weight and area; exact modes and scaling as the annuli approach the unit-circle boundary.
title: A gamma spectral law for fixed-area hyperbolic annuli in analytic wavelet localization
